component.name: SubDowner
component.summary: Search and download subtitles for movies and TV series

description.p: SubDowner is a modern GTK4/Libadwaita application that searches for subtitles using the OpenSubtitles REST API and Gestdown API. Results from both backends are merged and deduplicated so you always get the best match.

ul.li: Dual-backend search across OpenSubtitles and Gestdown
Drag-and-drop video files for hash-based matching
Configurable download directory and hearing-impaired filter

description.p: Major release with restructured codebase, pagination, drag-and-drop, search history, keyboard shortcuts, and encoding normalization.
